description: This file is a JavaScript source file that provides functionality to initialize and manage bar chart visualizations using the Chart.js library within a web application. It registers necessary Chart.js components, defines functions to adapt styles based on theme, and exposes a public function to set up bar charts on canvases with specific ID patterns.

methods.name: getTextColor()
methods.description: Determines the text color for labels based on the current theme (dark or light).

methods.name: getGridColor()
methods.description: Determines the grid line color for charts based on the current theme.

methods.name: initBarCharts()
methods.description: Public function that initializes bar charts on all canvas elements with IDs starting with 'bar-chart-canvas-'. It configures each chart with data, styling, and theme responsiveness.
